items.title: Announcing Amazon Nova 2.5 Sonic with improved reasoning for voice agents
items.blurb: Today, we announce the general availability of Amazon Nova 2.5 Sonic, our latest speech-to-speech model for natural, real-time voice agents.

items.title: Cloudflare Open Sources Decision Models for AI Agents
items.blurb: During its recent “Birthday Week”, Cloudflare announced Clef, a set of open-weight AI models designed to choose between predefined options rather than generate text.

items.title: AWS Config now supports 77 new resource types
items.blurb: AWS Config now supports 77 additional AWS resource types across key services including Amazon EC2, Amazon S3 Files, and Amazon Q Business.

items.title: AWS Advanced Ruby Driver Wrapper is generally available
items.blurb: The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Advanced Ruby Driver Wrapper is now generally available for use with Amazon RDS and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and MySQL-compatible databases.

items.title: AWS Batch now supports Amazon EKS access entry authentication
items.blurb: AWS Batch now supports Amazon EKS access entry authentication for compute environments.

items.title: AWS Private CA now provides detailed certificate issuance logs
items.blurb: AWS Private CA announces detailed certificate issuance logs, a new AWS CloudTrail service event that records the complete certificate content, issuing CA information, requester identity, and signing status for every issuance.

items.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service introduces validation advisory for domain configuration changes
items.blurb: Amazon OpenSearch Service now provides validation advisory for domain configuration changes, which helps you make informed decisions about changes that carry risk but can still be applied.
